program.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about moving the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source mug with all visible mugs in the edited image, assess their positions relative to the same headphones, and inspect the source mug’s former location. Pass only if evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail only if evidence reliably establishes that the requested move made no progress. Use unknown if source-mug identity, movement, or relevant positions cannot be determined reliably. A mug on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved. If evidence establishes some relevant progress but not that the source mug itself reached the right side, treat that as partial progress rather than complete fulfillment or no progress.
nodes.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images; compare the source mug with all visible edited mugs, assess their left-to-right positions relative to the headphones, and inspect the source mug’s former location, allowing for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

d1: The binding currently emphasizes identity uncertainty so strongly that the node collapses to unresolved, despite visible evidence of partial progress: the source blue mug was left of the headphones, and the edited image shows a blue blurred remnant near its former location plus a mug on the right. Refine the decision logic to distinguish partial progress from complete fulfillment and no progress: assess whether the former-location remnant and right-side mug jointly support an attempted move, without treating the right-side mug alone as proof that it is the same mug. Preserve unresolved when the visual evidence genuinely cannot establish any relevant progress; do not force identity or a label. The trace is valid and has no transport, schema, or dependency failure, so focus on the semantic threshold for partial progress rather than execution. The high-confidence unresolved result is a reason to inspect that threshold, not evidence that the requested edit is absent.

observations.evidence: The source blue mug is clearly left of the headphones. In the edited image, there are two small mugs: one left of the headphones and one right, while a blue blurred shape remains near the source mug’s former location. The edited mugs’ appearance differs substantially from the source mug, so the images do not reliably establish which edited mug, if either, is the source mug. A mug is visible to the right, but its identity and movement cannot be confirmed.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image show evidence that the source mug was moved, even if its identity or final position cannot be confirmed?
findings.criteria: Compare the source mug’s former location with the edited image. Assess whether the blue blurred shape at that location is consistent with a remnant of the mug or instead leaves the former location unresolved, and whether the edited mugs or other visible evidence support any movement of the source mug. Do not infer movement merely from a mug appearing on the right.
findings.evidence: The source has one large blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image has a blue blurred shape near that location and two smaller, differently appearing mugs, one on each side of the headphones. The saved observation notes these features but leaves source-mug identity and movement unresolved.
findings.rationale: The existing check appropriately treats identity and movement as uncertain, but its broad unknown result does not separately establish whether there is evidence of partial progress. This focused investigation could help distinguish unresolved evidence from some progress without assuming that the right-side mug is the source mug.
